title: The island's animals with minds
about: Every animal on the island (wolves and deer) is a subject (LIVING_ONLY names them all) on the island; LIVING_ONLY names only them, so no person is thought for. The authority asks an animal's mind only while a person is within 25 tiles. Variant `animal-switches` turns on LIVING_ANIMAL_MINDS=pack,salient,choose; the default leaves them off.
gradient: Realism of hunting and herding, survival by kind, and calls and tokens per animal-hour, switches on against off.
